## Activity

Capture activity at West Gate Eye Clinic in November 2018 totalled 365 captures. This records the volume of imaging completed during the month and provides the basis for the quality and grading measures reported below. The activity figure is presented as a direct count of captures for the site and reporting period.

## Image quality

Image quality was recorded for the captured images. There were 13 ungradable captures, representing an ungradable rate of 3.6 per cent. This measure identifies the proportion of images that could not be used for grading and is reported alongside the total capture activity for the month.

## Grading

Grading identified 44 referable results. The median lag between image capture and grading was 6 days. The referable result count and the median lag provide the grading position for West Gate Eye Clinic in November 2018. Together, the reported measures describe activity, image usability and the timeliness of grading for the period.
